_comment: Third-party components the Basetool ships that are NOT Maven artifacts, so no Licensee report can see them (REQ-UI-021, ADR-0197). :frontend:generateOssLicenses merges this list into the Open-Source-Lizenzen page. Add an entry whenever a font, an image layer or any other non-Gradle third-party file starts shipping; the licence must be GPL-3.0-compatible or kept separate from the program (a font or a base-image layer is aggregated, not linked). OssBundledComponentsTest pins that every bundled font file is listed here and has its licence text beside it.
